events.name: document:changed

events.summary: Pages were created, renamed, moved or trashed.

methods.name: app.info
methods.summary: Get the app version, SDK version, theme and the open workspace.
methods.example:
const info = await app.info();
console.log(info.appVersion, info.theme);

methods.name: editor.getActive
methods.summary: Get the page open in the focused pane, or null when Home or nothing is open.

methods.name: editor.getMarkdown
methods.summary: Read the open page (or some of its blocks) as Markdown.
methods.details: Custom blocks such as embedded databases come out as a short placeholder.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.getBlocks
methods.summary: List the open page's blocks with ids, types, text and nested children.
methods.details: Use the ids with editor.updateBlock, editor.replaceBlocks, editor.removeBlocks and editor.insertMarkdown.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.getSelection
methods.summary: Get the selected text, the selected block ids and the block with the cursor.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.snapshot
methods.summary: Get word count, block count, plain text and outline of the open page.

methods.name: editor.insertMarkdown
methods.summary: Insert Markdown at the cursor, at the start or end, or before/after a block.

markdown.description: Markdown. Headings, lists, checklists (- [ ]), quotes, code fences, tables and images are supported.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.example: await app.editor.insertMarkdown({ markdown: "## Summary\n- one\n- two", position: "end" });

methods.name: editor.replaceBlocks
methods.summary: Replace blocks with new content parsed from Markdown.

markdown.description: Markdown. Headings, lists, checklists (- [ ]), quotes, code fences, tables and images are supported.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.updateBlock
methods.summary: Change one block's type, text or props (e.g. heading level, checked).
methods.details: Types: paragraph, heading (props.level 1-3), bulletListItem, numberedListItem, checkListItem (props.checked), quote, codeBlock (props.language).

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.removeBlocks
methods.summary: Remove blocks from the open page.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.setMarkdown
methods.summary: Replace the whole open page with Markdown.
methods.details: Undoable with editor.undo. Prefer targeted edits for small changes.

markdown.description: Markdown. Headings, lists, checklists (- [ ]), quotes, code fences, tables and images are supported.

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.insertBlocks

methods.name: editor.undo

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.redo

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.scrollToBlock

pageId.description: Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane.

methods.name: editor.openFind
methods.summary: Open the find bar (or find & replace) in the open page.

methods.name: pages.read

methods.summary: List databases with their row counts.

methods.name: databases.getSchema
methods.summary: Get a database's properties (columns) and views.

methods.name: databases.queryRows
methods.summary: Read a database's rows with values keyed by property name.
methods.details: Select/status values come back as option names. `where` matches exact values (case-insensitive for text).

where.description: Property name → value that must match.

methods.example: const rows = await app.databases.queryRows({ databaseId, where: { Status: "Done" } });

methods.name: databases.create
methods.summary: Create a database with properties.
methods.details: Property types: text, number, select, multiSelect, status, date, checkbox, url, email, phone, createdTime, lastEdited.

methods.summary: Add a property (column) to a database.

methods.name: databases.addRow
methods.summary: Add a row; values are keyed by property name.
methods.details: Dates: ISO "2026-03-01". Selects: option name (created if missing). Multi-select: array of names. Checkbox: boolean.

methods.name: databases.updateRow
methods.summary: Change a row's title and/or values (keyed by property name).

methods.name: databases.getView
methods.summary: Get one view with its filters, sorts, grouping, visible properties and calculations.

viewId.description: View id (defaults to the first view).

methods.name: databases.queryView
methods.summary: Read rows the way a view shows them (its filters and sorts applied), optionally with a search.

viewId.description: View id (defaults to the first view).

filters.description: Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO.

property.description: Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title).

value.description: Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty).

sorts.description: Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts).

property.description: Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title).

methods.example: const late = await app.databases.queryView({ databaseId, filters: [{ property: "Due", op: "before", value: "2026-01-01" }], sorts: [{ property: "Due" }] });

methods.name: databases.addView
methods.summary: Add a view (table, board, gallery, list or calendar) with optional filters, sorts and grouping.

filters.description: Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO.

property.description: Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title).

value.description: Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty).

sorts.description: Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts).

property.description: Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title).

Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title).

methods.example: await app.databases.addView({ databaseId, type: "board", name: "By status", groupBy: "Status", filters: [{ property: "Done", op: "is", value: false }] });

methods.summary: List the app components that can be styled or hidden.

methods.name: appearance.setTokens
methods.summary: Override design tokens (colors, fonts, radii, sizes) for light and/or dark.
methods.details: Keys are token names without the leading dashes, e.g. { accent: "#2f6fdf", "radius-md": "12px" }. A null value removes an override.

light.description: Token → CSS value for the light theme.

dark.description: Token → CSS value for the dark theme.

both.description: Token → CSS value for both themes.

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.example: await app.appearance.setTokens({ both: { accent: "#2f6fdf" }, dark: { bg: "#111418" } });

methods.name: appearance.styleComponent
methods.summary: Style or hide an app component (see appearance.listComponents).
methods.details: `css` is a list of declarations applied to the component's root, e.g. "border-radius: 16px; background: var(--bg-sunken)". Use `rules` for nested selectors.

css.description: CSS declarations for the component root. "" clears.

rules.description: Extra CSS rules; `&` is replaced by the component selector.

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.name: appearance.addCss
methods.summary: Add or replace a named CSS snippet applied to the whole app.

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.details: The assistant writes each chat's changes to its own layer; plugins get one too. Users manage them in Plugins → Created.

permissions.description: Permission ids.

methods.name: sidebar.list
methods.summary: List the right sidebar's tab groups (stacked panels) and every available tab.

methods.name: sidebar.setTab
methods.summary: Add or update a right-sidebar tab with Markdown (+ buttons) or a full HTML view.
methods.details: Tabs from plugins live while the plugin runs; tabs from the assistant are saved in the chat's customization layer. A new tab is added to the first group unless `group` says otherwise; `split: true` opens it in a new group below.

id.description: Tab id, unique for this plugin or layer (letters, digits, dots, dashes).

icon.description: Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line".

actions.description: Buttons under Markdown content; pressing one raises panel:action (plugins).

html.description: HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined.

open.description: Show the sidebar and activate the tab.

split.description: Open in a new group below the others.

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.example:
await app.sidebar.setTab({ id: "tasks", title: "Tasks", icon: "list-checks", html: "
    ", open: true });

methods.name: sidebar.removeTab

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.name: sidebar.openTab
methods.summary: Show the right sidebar and activate a tab (built-in: outline, backlinks, info, assistant).

split.description: Move it into a new group below.

methods.name: sidebar.setLayout
methods.summary: Arrange the right sidebar: stacked groups of tabs, their order, sizes and active tabs.
methods.details: Each group is a panel with its own tab strip; groups stack top to bottom and `size` is a relative height. Tabs not listed stay in the last group.

methods.name: sidebar.moveTab

group.description: Target group index; -1 = new group at the bottom.

methods.details: HTML widgets render in a 22px-high sandboxed frame (`width` px wide) and can call the App API with the owner's permissions.

icon.description: Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line".

html.description: HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined.

width.description: Width in px for HTML widgets.

command.description: Command id to run on click (see commands.list).

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.summary: Remove a status bar widget.

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.name: blocks.registerType
methods.summary: Register a custom editor block type rendered by an HTML view; it appears in the slash menu.
methods.details: Each block stores JSON data in the page. In the view, read it from `noteral.props.data` and save changes with `noteral.setData(next)`; `noteral.props.editable` says whether the page can be edited. Keep `type` stable: documents reference it.

type.description: Type id, e.g. "kanban-mini" (lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes).

icon.description: Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line".

html.description: HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined.

height.description: Initial height in px (the view auto-resizes).

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.example: await app.blocks.registerType({ type: "counter", title: "Counter", icon: "plus", defaultData: { n: 0 }, html: "<button class=n-btn id=b></button><script>const r=()=>b.textContent='Clicked '+noteral.props.data.n;r();noteral.onProps(r);b.onclick=()=>noteral.setData({n:noteral.props.data.n+1})</script>" });

methods.name: blocks.unregisterType
methods.summary: Remove a custom block type (existing blocks show a placeholder).

layer.description: Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look.

methods.name: blocks.listTypes
methods.summary: List custom block types.

methods.name: blocks.insert
methods.summary: Insert a custom block into the open page.

data.description: Block data (defaults to the type's defaultData).

after.description: Insert after this block id (default: end of page).

methods.name: blocks.setData
methods.summary: Replace the data of a custom block in the open page.

methods.name: nodes.registerType
methods.summary: Register a custom page type for the page tree, opened in a full-page HTML view.
methods.details: Items of this type are created with nodes.create or from the tree's New menu. The view gets `noteral.props` = { pageId, title, data, editable } and saves with `noteral.setData(next)`. Items can have children like folders.

The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined.

methods.name: plugins.create
methods.summary: Install (or update) a plugin written by the assistant. The user reviews the code and permissions first.
methods.details: code is plain JavaScript run in a sandbox. It must call Noteral.register(class extends Noteral.Plugin { async onload() {…} onunload() {…} }). Use this.app.<namespace>.<method>(params) for every App API method (e.g. this.app.sidebar.setTab, this.app.statusBar.setWidget, this.app.blocks.registerType, this.app.nodes.registerType, this.app.home.addWidget), this.addCommand({ id, title, run }), this.setStatus(itemId, text), this.setPanel(panelId, { title, markdown, actions }), this.onPanelAction(panelId, fn), this.onViewMessage(fn), this.registerEvent(eventName, fn), this.addStyles(css), this.loadData() / this.saveData(patch). The plugin is test-run first (see plugins.test) and, after installing, its start-up is checked: the result's `health` reports errors so you can fix and reinstall.

permissions.description: Permissions the code needs.

skipTest.description: Install even if the test run reports errors.
